fields.headline: Extends Sonja Biggs Educational Services' visual-impairment teacher contract to 2025; the $50,000 cap is unchanged
fields.summary: The board is asked to ratify an amendment extending the agreement from June 30, 2024 to June 30, 2025. Sonja Biggs Educational Services, Inc. provides a Teacher of the Visually Impaired who completes legally required assessments, serves students with documented or suspected visual impairments, joins Individualized Education Program (IEP) meetings, and keeps service logs. The attached amendment leaves the $50,000 not-to-exceed amount unchanged, so no money is added; the $50,000 is the existing limit for the contract.

24-1471.note: Corrected: the $50,000 is the contract's existing not-to-exceed amount, which the attached amendment leaves unchanged, so this vote adds no money.
24-1471.sourceIssue: The text gives a cost not to exceed $50,000 "(during term)" for an amendment whose attached form marks the not-to-exceed amount as unchanged, so the figure is the existing limit and not added money.

fields.headline: Extends LightHouse for the Blind's vision services for infants and toddlers to 2027; the $49,900 cap is unchanged
fields.summary: The board is asked to ratify an amendment extending the agreement from June 30, 2024 to June 30, 2027. LightHouse for the Blind, Little Learner Program would continue to provide Part C vision services to infants and toddlers from birth to age 3 and their families. The attached amendment leaves the $49,900 not-to-exceed amount unchanged, so no money is added; the $49,900 is the existing limit for the contract, now spanning the longer term.

24-1472.note: Corrected: the $49,900 is the contract's existing not-to-exceed amount, which the attached amendment leaves unchanged, so this vote adds no money.
24-1472.sourceIssue: The text gives a cost not to exceed $49,900 "(during term)" for an amendment whose attached form marks the not-to-exceed amount as unchanged, so the figure is the existing limit and not added money.

fields.headline: Extends Transcribing Mariners' Braille transcribing contract to June 2025; the $40,000 cap is unchanged
fields.summary: The board is asked to ratify an amendment extending the agreement from June 30, 2024 to June 30, 2025. Transcribing Mariners provides Braille transcription, tactile graphics, embossing, binding and digital files of curriculum and worksheets for District students who are blind and use Braille. The attached amendment leaves the $40,000 not-to-exceed amount unchanged, so no money is added; the $40,000 is the existing limit for the contract.

24-1473.note: Corrected: the $40,000 is the contract's existing not-to-exceed amount, which the attached amendment leaves unchanged, so this vote adds no money.
24-1473.sourceIssue: The text gives a cost not to exceed $40,000 "(during term)" for an amendment whose attached form marks the not-to-exceed amount as unchanged, so the figure is the existing limit and not added money.

fields.summary: Lowe Consulting Group will help the district manage labor relations under its Project Labor Agreement (PLA), coordinate the PLA's workforce development and employment programs, and monitor and report on how well it works. The limit is $183,810, made up of $167,100 for basic services and $16,710 for additional services. The official text lists basic services as $167,000, which does not match the agreement. The work runs from June 27, 2024 to June 30, 2025.

24-1668.note: The summary previously gave basic services as $167,000; the attached agreement shows $167,100, which matches the $183,810 total.
24-1668.sourceIssue: The stated total not-to-exceed of $183,810.00 is $100 more than its two parts as printed, $167,000.00 for Basic Services and $16,710.00 for Additional Services; the attached agreement states Basic Services as $167,100.00.
